description.p: MultiAGENT is a local-first coding workspace for coordinating agent sessions, reviewing source changes, and moving between project conversations.
The app combines persistent chat threads, Git-aware review surfaces, file previews, runtime profiles, and a compact command palette in one Linux desktop interface.
Flatpak builds run inside a sandbox and use user-owned project files, network access, and explicit host runtime bridges for coding-agent CLIs.
